task_description: Implement 6 requested changes in the kiro-athen React+TS+Vite+Supabase app: (1) allow enrolling in a private course you created, (2) catalog search by creator name, (3) numeric user level instead of 'L1', (4) no XP for re-answering an already-correct question, (5) full layout overhaul (remove top bar; persistent left sidebar with fixed order + unread indicator + theme toggle + profile footer; Painel as home with a draggable Duolingo-style trail, module carousel, top-down panel, courses/rooms selector, notice board), (6) profile page rework (level/xp/streak inside identity block, clickable Cursos/Amigos nav buttons, featured medals pinned into the identity block). Backend changes (items 1 and 4) ship as NEW supabase migrations; src/types/database.ts is generated and must not be hand-edited. All work on a new feature branch off main; no push/PR.
